resources.string: Roadbook Navigator uses your precise location to measure distances and to center the map. It is only used while the app is open and the screen is on.
Location access is turned off. Open the settings, go to Permissions, Location, choose \"Allow only while using the app\" and turn on \"Use precise location\".
Without precise location, the odometer cannot measure distances. When asked, choose \"Precise\" and \"While using the app\".
